subject: Post-demo: Buying path, security kickoff & systems-in-scope (next steps)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Parker <evelyn.parker@crestline.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Buying path, security kickoff & systems-in-scope (next steps)

Hi Evelyn — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and proposed immediate next steps so we stay aligned on the buying path and security intake: 

What we covered (summary)
- Product fit: Redwood dedicated pool + VPC private control plane looked aligned to your throughput & isolation ask.
- Decision criteria you called out: predictable latency, audit logs, and ability to run under your KMS for keys.
- Systems likely in scope: customer portal API, analytics/data lake (S3), mobile SDK (iOS/Android) for inference calls.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm the list of systems in scope (above) or add any I missed.
2) Can you provide the best contact for procurement and legal (names + emails)? If procurement prefers a single mailbox, include that.
3) Security kickoff: I attached a draft Redwood security questionnaire (light version) — can you confirm who on your side will own this intake?
4) Timeline: you mentioned an internal procurement window of ~3 weeks — if accurate, we can aim for an MSA review + security call the week of Sept 7.

Attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2026_Crestline_draft.pdf (draft)

If it's helpful we'll pre-fill obvious answers (hosting, SOC2 link, etc.) before we hand it to your security team — would save them time. Happy to book a 30-min security kickoff with one of our platform engineers next week if you share availability.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2026_Crestline_draft.pdf]

From: Evelyn Parker <evelyn.parker@crestline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Gellar <tom.gellar@crestline.com>, procurement@crestline.com
Date: 2026-08-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying path, security kickoff & systems-in-scope (next steps)

Thanks Jonas — appreciated the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Systems in scope: confirm the three you listed (customer portal API, analytics/data lake, mobile SDK) and add the internal fraud-service (hosted in our VPC) — will need a separate call about network reachability.
- Procurement contact: Tom Gellar (cc'd) will own contracting. procurement@crestline.com is monitored by our SOW/procurement team.
- Legal: I'll loop legal if we get to redlines on the MSA; for now Tom will coordinate.
- Security intake: I propose our security engineer, Miguel Sanchez (miguel.sanchez@crestline.com), own the questionnaire. He prefers a pre-filled doc if you can provide one.

About data residency / logs: can you confirm (1) whether Redwood retains request logs tied to PII by default, and (2) where backup snapshots for models are stored (region)? If we can get short answers and confirm SOC2 report location, Miguel can triage the questionnaire faster.

We'll aim to review your draft questionnaire by 9/3 — Tom, Miguel, and I will coordinate. If you can pre-fill the obvious items (SOC2 link, infra details, KMS support) that'd be great.

Best,
Evelyn
Director of Product Security | Crestline Financial
Evelyn.Parker@crestline.com

[Inline: On Mon, Aug 30, 2026 at 3:12 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com> wrote:]

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-31T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: Buying path, security kickoff & systems-in-scope (next steps)

Jonas — quick internal note: great capture. A couple tactical suggestions before we hand the questionnaire to Miguel: 

- I'll prepare a pre-fill security matrix (answers we normally provide for SOC2, encryption, logging, KMS, network segmentation) and attach it. That should cut review time.
- Recommend scheduling a 30-min intake with one of our security engineers (I suggest Marissa) — she can join the call and walk through the draft so Miguel doesn't have to start from zero.
- For the fraud-service network reachability ask, we should surface our recommended pattern (private peering + no public ingress) and a diagram — I'll add that to the pre-fill.

I'll attach the matrix in a sec. If you want I can draft the MSA redline summary for Tom to speed procurement.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pre-fill-security-matrix.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Gellar <tom.gellar@crestline.com>, procurement@crestline.com, Evelyn Parker <evelyn.parker@crestline.com>, miguel.sanchez@crestline.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAA & questionnaire handoff + suggested timeline

Hi Tom / Miguel / Evelyn — looping procurement and your security engineer. Per Evelyn and Lauren's notes, attached are: 
- Filled draft questionnaire (we pre-filled infrastructure, SOC2 references, KMS notes)
- Pre-fill security matrix from Lauren
- Initial MSA draft for procurement to review (DocuSign link below)

Suggested mutual action plan (MAA)
- Week of 9/7: Security intake call (Marissa + Miguel) to walk the questionnaire answers and confirm network reachability for fraud-service.
- 9/8–9/10: Legal & procurement review MSA + redline.
- 9/13: Target decision week (if procurement/legal sign off).

Quick answers to Evelyn's asks: 
- Do we retain request logs tied to PII by default? No — by default we store minimal request metadata. Any PII or payloads are stored only if customer opts-in; Redwood supports customer-controlled retention policies and can turn off payload persistence.
- Model backup snapshots: stored in the customer-region we provision (we can pin to us-east-1 for Crestline).
- SOC2 report: https://redwoodinference.com/compliance/soc2-report (we attached a redacted SOC2 link in the questionnaire).

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2026_Crestline_draft.pdf (pre-filled), pre-fill-security-matrix.xlsx, MSA_draft_for_review.docx

DocuSign (MSA): https://docusign.com/link/MSA-CRST-2026
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-crestline-security (all artifacts)

Please confirm who will own the intake call and what times next week work for Miguel.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2026_Crestline_draft.pdf; pre-fill-security-matrix.xlsx; MSA_draft_for_review.docx]

From: Tom Gellar <tom.gellar@crestline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@crestline.com
Cc: Evelyn Parker <evelyn.parker@crestline.com>, miguel.sanchez@crestline.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAA & questionnaire handoff + suggested timeline

Jonas — thanks for the documents and the clear plan. Procurement will review the MSA this week; we target to have first-pass redlines back by Friday 9/4. A few notes from procurement: 

- We will want to understand pricing for a Dedicated capacity baseline vs burst (estimate based on your earlier sizing). Can you have your pricing analyst / solutions engineering send a short one-pager?
- On data residency and retention: Miguel will confirm technical needs, but we likely need a clause about customer-controlled retention and auditability.
- Miguel, can you propose 2 slots for a 30-min intake (Tue 9/8 10–10:30 or Wed 9/9 14–14:30) — we can confirm.

Tom Gellar
Sr. Manager, Procurement | Crestline Financial
procurement@crestline.com
